en: Black‑and‑white image showing a formal European garden seen from the top of a grand balustraded staircase. Wide paths lead through manicured lawns, flowerbeds, and sculpted conifer trees toward a large central tree and a distant building partly hidden by foliage. Men and women in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths, giving the scene a leisurely park atmosphere. The image has the proportions and border style of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting can be clearly read.
